# Pyae Phyo Maung (PPM) — Portfolio & Systems Architecture

> Lead Systems Architect & Full-Stack Engineer building high-performance web platforms, local-first developer tools, and privacy-focused distributed software.

Pyae Phyo Maung is a full-stack engineer with 6+ years of production experience based in Thailand, specializing in React, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Cloudflare Pages edge distribution, and native Model Context Protocol (MCP) tooling.

## Key Architectural Case Studies

- **[JSON Link](https://pyaephyomaung.dev/projects/json-link)**: Zero-backend, local-first localization studio and spreadsheet workspace with two-way local disk synchronization via the Web File System Access API, AES-GCM 256-bit client-side encryption, and native Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for Claude Code and Cursor.
- **[ToastStar](https://pyaephyomaung.dev/projects/toaststar)**: Production notification engine with center-launch physics, hover fan-out stacks, queue-aware scheduling, and multi-app scoping.
- **[DeskKit](https://pyaephyomaung.dev/projects/deskkit)**: Local-first in-browser privacy suite for real-time PII masking, PDF redaction, and client-side encrypted notes using Web Crypto.
- **[DCMS](https://pyaephyomaung.dev/projects/dcms)**: Digital Clinic Management System with role-based access control, appointment queuing, and automated clinical billing workflows.
